title: Wayfare Pass Ride Credit Earning Schedule by Plan
content:
# Ride credit earning schedule — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

Pass ride credit is the credit a Wayfare Pass member earns on the eligible fare of eligible completed trips. The plan figures that govern earning are scheduled here for every plan.

## Rates, caps and minimum fare

| Plan | Pass ride credit rate (percent of the eligible fare) | Per-trip cap (USD) | Monthly cap (USD) | Minimum eligible fare (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Student | 6 | 10.00 | 40.00 | 5.00 |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | 6 | 10.00 | 60.00 | 5.00 |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | 6 | 10.00 | 60.00 | 5.00 |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | 10 | 15.00 | 100.00 | 5.00 |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | 10 | 15.00 | 100.00 | 5.00 |
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | 10 | 20.00 | 125.00 | 5.00 |

- The **rate** is the Pass ride credit earned on the eligible fare of each eligible completed trip, in percent.
- The **per-trip cap** is the most Pass ride credit one trip can earn.
- The **monthly cap** is the most Pass ride credit that can be earned in one calendar month.
- The **minimum eligible fare**: trips whose eligible fare is below this amount earn no credit.

## Credit-earning ride options

| Plan | Ride options whose trips earn Pass ride credit |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Student | Wayfare Shared, Wayfare Standard, Wayfare Green, Wayfare Comfort, Wayfare XL |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | Wayfare Shared, Wayfare Standard, Wayfare Green, Wayfare Comfort, Wayfare XL |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | Wayfare Shared, Wayfare Standard, Wayfare Green, Wayfare Comfort, Wayfare XL |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | Wayfare Shared, Wayfare Standard, Wayfare Green, Wayfare Comfort, Wayfare XL, Wayfare Black |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | Wayfare Shared, Wayfare Standard, Wayfare Green, Wayfare Comfort, Wayfare XL, Wayfare Black |
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | Wayfare Shared, Wayfare Standard, Wayfare Green, Wayfare Comfort, Wayfare XL, Wayfare Black, Wayfare Black SUV |

## Terms common to every plan

| Term | Value on every plan |
|---|---|
| Charges never part of the eligible fare | wait time, tolls, airport fee, Priority Pickup, reservation fee, cancellation fee, no-show fee, tip, booking fee |
| Reserved trips earn credit like on-demand trips | yes |
| Posting delay | 48 hours after drop-off before earned credit becomes available to spend |
| Month basis for monthly caps and allowances | calendar month in the member's home market time |

The charges listed are never part of the eligible fare; the eligible fare is the fare charge amount less the booking fee. Monthly credit caps and allowances count by calendar month in the member's home market time.

## Points of reading

- *Does a Wayfare Black SUV trip earn credit on Wayfare Pass Plus Annual?* No; Wayfare Black SUV is listed only for Wayfare Pass All Access Annual.
- *Does a Wayfare Pass Student member earn on a Wayfare Black trip?* No; the Student list stops at Wayfare XL.
- *Hypothetical illustration of the per-trip cap:* at a 10 percent rate, an eligible fare of 180.00 gives 18.00, which the 15.00 per-trip cap of Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly limits to 15.00 and the 20.00 cap of Wayfare Pass All Access Annual leaves at 18.00.
